items.title: Should CFO Appointment Require Action From Insulet (PODD) Investors?
items.summary: Insulet appointed Todd Trapp as Chief Financial Officer and Executive Vice President effective 7 December 2026, with outgoing CFO Flavia Pease staying on in an advisory role to support a phased handover. The incoming finance chief brings three decades of MedTech and Industrials experience across Resonetics, Abiomed, Watts Water Technologies and Honeywell, aligning deep sector know how with Insulet’s focus on scaling its Omnipod franchise globally.
